title: What If a Whole Country Declared War on One Small Bird?

scenes.text: What if a whole country declared war on one small bird? China did, and nature fought back.
In 1958 the Four Pests campaign targeted sparrows, which were believed to eat grain.
People banged pots and pans so the birds could not land, and destroyed their nests.
But sparrows also eat insects, including locusts. With fewer birds, locusts damaged crops.
Researchers link the campaign to worse harvests during the Great Leap Forward, one factor among several in a deadly famine.
China later imported sparrows from the Soviet Union, and the campaign shifted to bedbugs instead.

description:
